name: Treace Medical Concepts, Inc.
summary: Treace Medical Concepts, Inc., a medical technology company, designs, manufactures, and markets medical devices in the United States. The company offers Lapiplasty System, enables surgeons to correct all three dimensions of the bunion deformity, stabilize the first TMT joint, and allow return to weight-bearing in a walking boot; minimally invasive products for four bunion classes; Nanoplasty 3D Minimally Invasive Bunion Correction System delivers a reproducible 3D correction of the bunion deformity through a cosmetically appealing; and Percuplasty Percutaneous 3D Bunion Correction System that provides 3D correction of the bunion deformity through percutaneous incisions.
